chapters.title: Chapter 4 - Bendu's Work and Pain
chapters.summary_simple: SS1 Quick: Bendu works at peace centre helping war-affected girls. She still hides her secret.
chapters.summary_detailed: Chapter 4 continues Bendu's story from Chapter 1. At peace centre with Agnes and Tenneh, she counsels girls. She still remembers Granny May in wheelbarrow and Commander Cobra breaking her finger. She fears her family will judge her secret about one year with fighters. Theme: trauma, healing.

chapters.title: Chapter 5 - Moses and the Street Boys
chapters.summary_simple: SS1 Quick: Moses Varney promises to help Simeon and Alphonso get off the street.
chapters.summary_detailed: Chapter 5 links to Chapter 2. Moses Varney remembers his bus accident that killed his parents from Sanniquellie to Monrovia. He sees himself in street boys Simeon and Alphonso. He tells Weah to arrange food and school. He thinks No justice, no peace. Aligned to Chapter 2 Temple of Justice.

chapters.title: Chapter 6 - The Truth Commission Begins
chapters.summary_simple: SS1 Quick: Liberia starts Truth and Reconciliation Commission. Bendu is invited to speak.
chapters.summary_detailed: TRC begins. Bendu is invited by Calvin Daniels. She fears Commander Cobra will be mentioned. Moses Varney also called as former fighter. This connects Chapter 1 rebel attack and Chapter 2 justice vow.

chapters.title: Chapter 7 - Confronting the Past
chapters.summary_simple: SS1 Quick: Bendu remembers her year with rebels after Granny May died.
chapters.summary_detailed: Bendu flashes back to dark rebel camp in woods after she fainted in Chapter 1. She spent one year with fighters. She does not want family to know. Aligns to Chapter 1 secret.

chapters.title: Chapter 8 - Agnes and Tenneh Stories
chapters.summary_simple: SS1 Quick: Agnes and Tenneh share their war stories with Bendu.
chapters.summary_detailed: Agnes and Tenneh at peace centre share their own trauma. This helps Bendu understand she is not alone. Continues sisterhood from Chapter 1 memorial friends.

chapters.title: Chapter 9 - Moses Varney's Campaign
chapters.summary_simple: SS1 Quick: Moses campaigns for justice and youth. People see him as Brother V.
chapters.summary_detailed: Moses continues his 'In the Cause of the People' campaign. He visits communities. Weah protects him. Simeon follows him. His past as Cobra haunts him.

chapters.title: Chapter 10 - The Camp Memory
chapters.summary_simple: SS1 Quick: Bendu finally remembers full details of rebel camp where she woke up in Chapter 1.
chapters.summary_detailed: Bendu remembers waking up in dark after Samson broke her finger in Chapter 1. The camp, the fire, the fear. She remembers how Commander Cobra stopped Samson. Aligns directly to Chapter 1 ending.

chapters.title: Chapter 11 - Siatta and Family Tension
chapters.summary_simple: SS1 Quick: Siatta, Bendu's sister, and Terrance worry about Bendu's silence.
chapters.summary_detailed: Siatta and Terrance Clarke house Bendu's parents Ben and Eva Lewis from Chapter 1. They notice Bendu is withdrawn after Granny May memorial. Family tension grows.

chapters.title: Chapter 12 - The First Hearing
chapters.summary_simple: SS1 Quick: First TRC hearing starts. Survivors say let bygones be bygones but Bendu cannot forget.
chapters.summary_detailed: At TRC, some say forget war. Bendu from Chapter 1 feels she cannot forget wheelbarrow escape and broken finger. Moses listens. Links to Chapter 1 theme.

chapters.title: Chapter 13 - Bendu Testifies
chapters.summary_simple: SS1 Quick: Bendu testifies about pushing Granny May in wheelbarrow and being taken by rebels.
chapters.summary_detailed: Bendu tells her Chapter 1 story publicly: rusty wheelbarrow, Granny May whispering 'Leave me baby', Samson breaking her finger, waking in dark camp. First time family hears secret.

chapters.title: Chapter 14 - Commander Cobra Revealed
chapters.summary_simple: SS1 Quick: Moses Varney is revealed as Commander Cobra from Chapter 1.
chapters.summary_detailed: People realize Moses Varney tall man with moustache from Temple of Justice in Chapter 2 is same Commander Cobra who took Bendu in Chapter 1. Shock in hall.

chapters.title: Chapter 15 - The Secret Comes Out
chapters.summary_simple: SS1 Quick: Bendu's one year with fighters secret is fully told.
chapters.summary_detailed: Bendu explains what happened in one year she spent with fighters after Chapter 1 capture. How she survived. Family finally understands why she felt alone at memorial.

chapters.title: Chapter 16 - Jonah's Memory
chapters.summary_simple: SS1 Quick: Bendu remembers her late fiance Jonah she wanted to join in heaven in Chapter 1.
chapters.summary_detailed: Bendu remembers Jonah, her late fiance mentioned in Chapter 1 when she sucked teeth at rebels and wanted to die. She explains why she was not afraid of rebels.

chapters.title: Chapter 17 - Forgiveness and Anger
chapters.summary_simple: SS1 Quick: Family struggles to forgive. Bendu's parents react to truth.
chapters.summary_detailed: Ben and Eva Lewis from Chapter 1 who returned from America for memorial react. Siatta angry at Moses. Bendu torn between anger and forgiveness. Links to family background in Chapter 1.

chapters.title: Chapter 18 - The Community Reaction
chapters.summary_simple: SS1 Quick: Community reacts to Moses being Cobra. Street boys Simeon defend him.
chapters.summary_detailed: News spreads Monrovia that Brother V is ex-rebel Commander Cobra from Chapter 1. Simeon and Alphonso from Chapter 2 defend him because he helped them. Community divided.

chapters.title: Chapter 19 - Moses Confesses
chapters.summary_simple: SS1 Quick: Moses Varney confesses his rebel past and bus accident childhood.
chapters.summary_detailed: Moses tells his full story: losing parents in Sanniquellie bus accident overloaded with chickens and goat in Chapter 2 memory, becoming rebel, becoming Commander Cobra in Chapter 1, now wanting justice. He says IN THE CAUSE OF THE PEOPLE.

chapters.title: Chapter 20 - The Road to Duluma
chapters.summary_simple: SS1 Quick: Bendu and Moses travel back to Charlue Town road where Granny May died.
chapters.summary_detailed: Bendu and Moses return to dusty road from Chapter 1 where she pushed wheelbarrow. They revisit trauma site for reconciliation. Old man who told her God will bless you is found.

chapters.title: Chapter 21 - Granny May's Village
chapters.summary_simple: SS1 Quick: They visit Granny May's village to honor her.
chapters.summary_detailed: They go to Granny May Catherine May Tyler Lewis village. Family portrait and Bible from empty casket in Chapter 1 are placed at her home. Bendu finally mourns properly.

chapters.title: Chapter 22 - Reconciliation Meeting
chapters.summary_simple: SS1 Quick: Bendu and Moses have private reconciliation without TRC.
chapters.summary_detailed: Bendu and Moses meet face to face. She tells how he broke her finger with gun in Chapter 1. He asks forgiveness. She remembers he also stopped Samson from hitting her.

chapters.title: Chapter 23 - The Youth Centre
chapters.summary_simple: SS1 Quick: Moses opens youth centre for Simeon and street boys.
chapters.summary_detailed: Moses fulfills promise from Chapter 2 'I won't forget you' to Simeon. He opens centre at Capitol Bypass. Bendu brings peace centre girls Agnes and Tenneh to join. Youth unemployment theme from Chapter 2 addressed.

chapters.title: Chapter 24 - Calvin and the Journalists
chapters.summary_simple: SS1 Quick: Calvin Daniels reports TRC story to press.
chapters.summary_detailed: Calvin from Chapter 1 peace centre friend documents Bendu and Moses reconciliation. Press wants sensational story. Calvin protects truth.

chapters.title: Chapter 25 - The Night in the Bush
chapters.summary_simple: SS1 Quick: Detailed memory of first night Bendu woke in rebel camp in woods.
chapters.summary_detailed: Full flashback to Chapter 1 ending: dark, camp in woods, hunger, pain, broken finger, fear. Bendu explains how she survived night. Aligns to Chapter 1 scene 5 secret.

chapters.title: Chapter 26 - Bendu and Moses Meet Again
chapters.summary_simple: SS1 Quick: Bendu and Moses decide to work together for peace.
chapters.summary_detailed: After reconciliation, Bendu and Moses agree to jointly run peace education. Former victim and former Commander Cobra now partners for justice. Fulfills Moses vow from Chapter 2 about people liberating themselves.

chapters.title: Chapter 27 - No Justice No Peace
chapters.summary_simple: SS1 Quick: Community debates justice. Moses quotes his sticker.
chapters.summary_detailed: Moses repeats IN THE CAUSE OF THE PEOPLE, THE STRUGGLE CONTINUES from dashboard in Chapter 2. He says no peace without equity. Community starts to understand Chapter 2 philosophy.

chapters.title: Chapter 28 - The Letter
chapters.summary_simple: SS1 Quick: Bendu writes letter to Granny May about forgiveness.
chapters.summary_detailed: Bendu writes to Granny May Catherine May Tyler Lewis from Chapter 1 memorial. She tells Granny she tried to save her in wheelbarrow, she was taken, now she forgives. She puts letter in empty casket Bible.

chapters.title: Chapter 29 - Return to Charlue Town
chapters.summary_simple: SS1 Quick: Family returns to Charlue Town where escape started in Chapter 1.
chapters.summary_detailed: Ben, Eva, Siatta, Terrance, Bendu return to Charlue Town. They see rusty wheelbarrow still on road? They honor abandoned babies from Chapter 1 escape. Healing journey.

chapters.title: Chapter 30 - The Trial
chapters.summary_simple: SS1 Quick: Samson is tried. Commander Cobra Moses testifies against him.
chapters.summary_detailed: Samson with dreadlocks from Chapter 1 who broke Bendu finger is tried. Moses Varney testifies he stopped Samson from worse in Chapter 1. Justice for Bendu.

chapters.title: Chapter 31 - The Verdict
chapters.summary_simple: SS1 Quick: Verdict given. Moses gets conditional forgiveness.
chapters.summary_detailed: Court decides Moses Varney showed remorse and helped youth like Simeon and Alphonso from Chapter 2. He is not jailed but must continue youth centre work. Aligns to justice theme from Chapter 2.

chapters.title: Chapter 32 - Healing the Land
chapters.summary_simple: SS1 Quick: Bendu and Moses plant white rose at Granny May memorial site.
chapters.summary_detailed: White rose from empty casket in Chapter 1 is planted. Liberian flag raised. Community ceremony. Old man from road who blessed Bendu in Chapter 1 attends. Symbolic healing of land.

chapters.title: Chapter 33 - Bendu's New Beginning
chapters.summary_simple: SS1 Quick: Bendu decides to stay in Liberia and continue peace work, not return to America.
chapters.summary_detailed: Ben and Eva Lewis return to America after memorial in Chapter 1, but Bendu stays. She chooses peace centre over America. She finally feels not alone like she felt at memorial in Chapter 1. Agnes, Tenneh, Calvin celebrate.

chapters.title: Chapter 34 - Redemption Road
chapters.summary_simple: SS1 Quick: Final chapter - Bendu and Moses walk Redemption Road together. Forgiveness is the road.
chapters.summary_detailed: Final chapter ties all. Bendu who pushed Granny May in rusty wheelbarrow in Chapter 1 and Moses who was Commander Cobra who took her and later became Brother V at Temple of Justice in Chapter 2 now walk together on new road. They call it Redemption Road. Bendu forgave. Moses redeemed by helping Simeon and youth. Theme: Love, loss, trauma of war, survival, justice, and redemption. The empty casket from Chapter 1 now filled with hope. Moral: No justice, no peace, but redemption is possible.
chapters.theme: Redemption, Forgiveness, Love, Hope - Final Message
chapters.setting: Redemption Road - Monrovia to Charlue Town
